entities.name: Ewa Wiśnierska
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ewa Wiśnierska is a Polish paraglider, a member of the German national paragliding team, who won the Paragliding World Cup on several occasions. In 2007, she survived extreme cold, lightning and lack of oxygen during an ascent to almost 10,000 metres (33,000 ft) inside a cumulonimbus cloud.

entities.summary: Ewa Wiśnierska is a Polish paraglider, a member of the German national paragliding team, who won the Paragliding World Cup on several occasions. In 2007, she survived extreme cold, lightning and lack of oxygen during an ascent to almost 10,000 metres (33,000 ft) inside a cumulonimbus cloud.
